head: e53464c73f31f7aca800f3867ac054c36408e346
identity: Both push events, main branch, exact e534, attempt1, completed failure. Job metadata and each failing job log fetched once.

batch.cause: REGISTRY_RING_TOKEN empty; explicit missing-credential guard exits1 before gh workflow run. No ring sent.
batch.classification: Expected suppressed operation consistent with the user-authorized registry pause; not new classifier/main-source regression.
batch.tracked: Closed #4966 explicitly introduced loud missing-token reporting. Open search matches otherwise concern local jq harness prerequisites, not this live failure.
batch.limits: Workflow text claims a next cron pickup, but registry Actions are intentionally OFF: no automatic pickup is assumed. Later workflow_run success does not repair or execute the push-only ring; overflow job in this run was skipped.

release.phase: Release-PR package/version determination; failing terminal step is the privileged-token containment check.
release.cause: release-plz reports failed to determine next versions -> failed to run cargo package -> sparq-introspect v0.1.1 cannot resolve package sparq-engine from crates.io index. The failed package has a versioned dev-dependency on sparq-engine at Cargo.toml:78.
release.classification: Genuine packaging/bootstrap failure, not the known Actions PR-creation403 hold and not proved transient. App token was successfully minted; release-pr failed before a PR could be opened by that command. Containment correctly exits1 for provisioned App/PAT failure.
release.policy: Releases remain unauthorized; publish=false and git_only=true are configured. That policy does not make a cargo package error an expected permission-hold success.
release.limits: No packaging reproduction, registry availability probe, tag-job log or artifact inspection. Sibling tag job metadata says success; this does not prove tag creation, publication or healthy release packaging. Exact dependency-cycle/order repair is unproven and deliberately not implemented.

gate_impact: Both exact failed job names are explicitly declared advisory in .github/advisory-registry.json:219 and226. Their failures do not establish aggregate/main-gate regression. The e534 merge changes only the two classifier Python files, not these workflows or Cargo/release metadata.

dedupe.related_issue3337: OPEN; configure crates.io token/cargo owner. This is a broader prerequisite, not an exact report of the observed packaging failure.
dedupe.source_comment3399: The source comment cites #3399 as first-release bootstrap; exact issue read is CLOSED npm-name decision, so it is not evidence of this failure being tracked. No broad correction proposed.
dedupe.limit: Two targeted searches do not prove repository-wide absence of another duplicate.

one_recommended_followup: Root may record one deferred, tightly scoped release-bootstrap packaging finding (sparq-introspect versioned dev-dependency on unpublished sparq-engine), relating #3337 and attaching this failure evidence; verify final duplicate status before any new issue. Do not provision credentials, authorize publishing, rerun or weaken containment to address this observation.
actions: Read-only GitHub API and local source/evidence reads only. No retries, mutations, workflow/model/build calls, release/registry changes. PR6095 worktree and its frozen recovery packet remain unchanged.
